description: Primary literature, preprints, datasets, methods, and correction status. Plus the education-statistics feature's institution statistics (US IPEDS by UNITID, ETER by ETER ID) and country education and R&D indicators (UNESCO UIS, OECD Education at a Glance and Eurostat R&D through the SDMX connector), each value with its definition, unit, reference period and release vintage.
